Tap a preset to use it in Custom mode. The selected preset\'s instruction is appended to the system prompt; effective from the next request.
Falls back to the single custom instruction string; pick a preset for reusable behavior

Shown in the preset list and chat header chip
Appended to the system prompt in Custom mode. Use MUST / NEVER style constraints for best compliance.

Execution profiles per level (iterations scale / verification / tool-output budget) — details in the mode guide docs

Chat input exposes TWO independent controls: model-native reasoning effort (API params, thinking-capable models only) and the Force-deep-thinking switch (prompt-level, any model — pins the level at MAXIMUM). The table below is the engine-side profile reference.
Casual conversation, emotional companionship, knowledge Q&A, creative writing
Single-turn streaming reply; persona + chat skills injected; no tools, no ceremony
None — pure conversation; the toolkit ring lives in the Coding screen
You drive every turn; nothing runs autonomously
Mode: CHAT section — conversational, warm, matches your energy
Everyday tasks, research, automation, device control — anything non-coding
ReAct loop with general tools (web search, memory, system…); coding tools excluded
General CORE set; code_*/git/github removed — programming is redirected to Coding mode
ask_user on ambiguity; no forced function calling UI (that lives in Coding)
Mode: AGENT section — all-round non-coding agent, advises Coding for code
Periodic checks: poll a status page, watch a folder, repeated cleanups, one-shot reminders
LoopScheduler fires the prompt on schedule (interval / cron / once); each run is one full agent turn
Same tool surface as AGENT; repeated runs should stay idempotent (check state before acting)
You configure the loop (prompt, schedule, max runs) and can stop it anytime; runs auto-log to the session
Mode: LOOP section — scheduled re-runs, concise per-run status, idempotency discipline
Verifiable missions: "all tests pass", "build succeeds", "page returns 200 under 300ms"
Work rounds like BUILD; on each natural finish a fast model verifies the acceptance criteria; failing rounds auto-continue with the gap note
Full coding tool surface (Build-grade); verification evidence (commands/outputs) beats narration
You set the goal + verifiable criteria + max rounds; stop/resume anytime; verdicts stream into the thinking panel
Mode: GOAL section — verifiable objective, evidence-based completion report, no early stop
